evidence: Room carry policy (run 20261101T113949): 78.9% success over 256 random rooms (2-3 kg 88%, 3-4 kg 69%) vs 42.6% for scripted docking.

Lift probes (run 20261101T092539): 2 and 4 kg were lifted and carried; 6 kg sped up and fell; 8 and 10 kg did not leave the floor with the wrist pitch joints at their 5 Nm limit (static load 1.28 Nm per kg).
Static analysis: a centred grasp would cut the wrist load to 0.45 Nm per kg, but it puts a 0.9 m tall cabinet against the knees while walking.
Straight push policy (run 20261030T173207): 87.9% success vs 27.3% scripted, pushing a 0.7 x 0.8 x 1.0 m box 1 m on furniture sliders (friction 0.05-0.15), 5-20 kg.
The palms push 0.15 m left and right of the centre, so the pushed face must be at least about 0.36 m wide.
